national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Emphasizes Integration of Science and Security at National Defence College
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu interacted with faculty and course members of the 66th National Defence College Course at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
Highlighted that modern warfare extends into cyber security, space technology, and biotechnology, requiring close cooperation between scientific institutions and armed forces.
Emphasized the significance of government initiatives like the Research, Development and Innovation Scheme in bridging innovation and national security.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Bloomberg New Economy Forum, Highlights India's Economic Resilience and Digital Power
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi, stating that India's GDP growth stood at 7.8% in the first quarter of the financial year.
Highlighted that India's foreign exchange reserves exceed 700 billion dollars and the startup ecosystem has crossed 2,50,000 startups.
Noted that the government has embodied the principle of 'Power to Empower', with digital power serving as a key driver of transformation.

national_news.title: India Hosts First BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi, focusing on regional security and counter-terrorism.
Reaffirmed India's zero-tolerance policy towards terrorism and emphasized real-time intelligence sharing and legal cooperation among member states.
BIMSTEC, established in 1997, comprises seven member states: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Thailand.

national_news.title: Shafali Verma and Shubman Gill Named ICC Players of the Month for September 2026
bullets: Shafali Verma won the ICC Women’s Player of the Month for September 2026 following stellar performances in the Women’s Asia Cup.
Shubman Gill claimed the ICC Men’s Player of the Month award for a record fifth time following his outstanding ODI series against the West Indies.
Gill scored 333 runs in the first two matches against West Indies, including a century and an unbeaten double century.

national_news.title: Indian Coast Guard Inducts Indigenous ALH MK-III Helicopter in Maharashtra
bullets: The Indian Coast Guard inducted the indigenous Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH MK-III) aircraft, CG 875, into Coast Guard Region (West) at Ratnagiri, Maharashtra.
The helicopter is equipped with Advanced Radar, Electro Optical Pod, Automatic Identification System, and a cabin-mounted 12.7 mm Heavy Machine Gun.
It is the first of five allotted ALH MK-III aircraft to be positioned with 831 Sqn (CG) at Ratnagiri to enhance maritime surveillance and security within the EEZ.

national_news.title: New Delhi Launches EV Charging Stations and Air Quality Monitoring Stations
bullets: Union Minister Bhupender Yadav and Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta launched 5 public EV charging stations and 13 Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Stations in New Delhi.
The initiative aims to strengthen real-time monitoring of the Air Quality Index (AQI) across the national capital.
The Delhi government increased its combined fleet of electric and CNG buses to over 5,500 in alignment with the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) directives.

national_news.title: Ministry of Railways Announces Pan-India Rail Jan Samvaad and Reviews Special Campaign 6
bullets: The Ministry of Railways scheduled a citizen-centric pan-India 'Rail Jan Samvaad' across all railway stations on 22.10.2026.
Under the Special Campaign for Disposal of Pending Matters 6 (SCDPM-6), targets include cleaning 100,000 sites, freeing 700,000 sq. ft. of space, and generating ₹600 crore from scrap disposal.
The campaign emphasizes effective collection, segregation, and disposal of e-waste as per E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.

national_news.title: Indian Navy Commissions INS Mangrol, Mahe-Class ASW SWC
bullets: INS Mangrol (P82), the third Mahe-class Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW-SWC), was commissioned into the Indian Navy at Naval Dockyard, Mumbai on October 12, 2026.

The ship is indigenously designed and constructed by Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), Kochi, featuring over 80 percent indigenous content under the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' and 'Make in India' initiatives.
It is equipped for Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW), underwater surveillance, Low-Intensity Maritime Operations (LIMO), and mine warfare tasks in coastal and shallow waters.

national_news.title: Growth and Performance of Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)
bullets: KVIC is a statutory body established under the Khadi and Village Industries Commission Act, 1956, tasked with planning, promoting, and facilitating village industries.
In FY 2025-26, sales of Khadi and Village Industries products reached a historic ₹1.87 lakh crore, marking a 501% growth compared to 2013-14.
Employment in the sector rose to 2.04 crore, with women constituting more than 80% of artisans in the Khadi sector and over 50% of trainees under KVIC programs.
The Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP), active since March 2008, has provided employment opportunities to nearly 97.95 lakh people.

national_news.title: Centre Caps Trade Margins on Anti-Cancer Drugs at 30% of MRP
bullets: The Union government informed the Supreme Court that trade margins on anti-cancer medicines have been capped at 30 percent of the maximum retail price (MRP).
Solicitor General Tushar Mehta stated that the Centre will notify a periodically updated list of cancer drugs subject to this cap while excluding inexpensive medicines.
The Supreme Court raised concerns over substantial price disparities between retailer supply costs and MRPs, calling for a broader review of medicine pricing beyond anti-cancer drugs.

national_news.title: India and UK Aim to Double Bilateral Trade by 2030 at 16th JETCO Session
bullets: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal addressed the 16th Session of the India-UK Joint Economic and Trade Committee (JETCO) Business Plenary in New Delhi.
The Minister set a target to double India-UK bilateral trade by 2030, leveraging the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA).
CETA provides zero-duty access for major Indian exports such as pharmaceuticals, smartphones, textiles, and auto components into the UK market.

national_news.title: Centre Directs States to Ensure Transparent Pricing Displays at Clinical Establishments
bullets: Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava urged States and UTs to ensure mandatory, prominent display of service charges at clinical establishments.
The measure aims to prevent billing disputes, increase healthcare pricing transparency, and assist patients in making informed treatment decisions.
States were requested to facilitate transparent package pricing for foreign national visitors on Medical and Ayush Visas to boost medical tourism.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Uses AI to Restore Ancient Mundeshwari Temple
bullets: The Mundeshwari Temple in Kaimur district, Bihar, is dedicated to Maa Durga and Lord Shiva and is believed to be the world's oldest functional Hindu temple, dating back to 108 CE.
The site has been protected by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) since 1915.

The Bihar Heritage Development Society (BHDS) has initiated a scientific process using 3D measurements and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to reconstruct the original Nagara-style form of the temple from scattered architectural debris.

bihar_news.title: ICAR-MGIFRI Organizes Training on Crop Management in Flood-Affected Lands
bullets: ICAR–Mahatma Gandhi Integrated Farming Research Institute (ICAR-MGIFRI), Motihari, organized a three-day residential training programme on post-flood crop management in Diara and Chaur lands.
The programme was sponsored by the Bihar Agricultural Management and Extension Training Institute (BAMETI), Patna.
Key focus areas included climate-resilient farming, zero-tillage, residual soil moisture utilization, and Integrated Farming Systems (IFS) combining crop, livestock, and aquatic resources.

bihar_news.title: Gaya Named Best Performer Under PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
bullets: Gaya (Bihar), Nagaur (Rajasthan), and Umaria (Madhya Pradesh) were recognized as the best-performing aspirational districts in the first year of the Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PM-DDKY).
PM-DDKY integrates 36 central schemes across 11 ministries with an annual outlay of ₹24,000 crore, targeting low crop productivity, low cropping intensity, and low agricultural credit disbursement.
Union Agriculture Minister announced the 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan' to be held from October 22 to November 30, 2026, to promote soil health and balanced fertilizer use.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Aims to Become Hub of Entrepreneurship and Innovation
bullets: Bihar aims to become a major hub of entrepreneurship, employment, and innovation under the double-engine government.
The state cabinet resolved to make Bihar an active participant in building a developed India by 2047.
Over Rs 13 lakh crore has been directly transferred to the Bihar government by the Centre over the last 12 years.

bihar_news.title: Bodh Gaya Emporium Plan to Expand Market Access for Bihar's Jeevika Women
bullets: The Bihar Rural Development Department directed the expedited construction of an emporium at Bodh Gaya to provide Jeevika women access to domestic and international buyers.
Similar facilities are planned at other major tourist destinations in the state to showcase local handicrafts and traditional artworks.
Additional initiatives include establishing block-level Sudha milk outlets operated by Jeevika women and organizing the Saras fair at Gandhi Maidan from December 12 to 28.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Green Hydrogen Policy 2026 and Greenfield Satellite Townships
bullets: Bihar Green Hydrogen Policy 2026 aims to establish an annual green hydrogen production capacity of 1 lakh tonnes within five years, attracting ₹16,000 crore in investment.
The policy is expected to generate over 12,000 direct and indirect employment opportunities in the state.
Bihar's Greenfield Satellite Township scheme involves developing 12 planned urban settlements with ₹1 lakh crore long-term financing from HUDCO, spanning across 11 locations.
Phase I of the satellite township covers 7 locations (Patna, Sonepur, Gaya, Darbhanga, Purnea, Saharsa, Munger) and Phase II covers 4 locations (Sitamarhi, Chapra, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur).
